name: Redmine
description: Your Redmine tasks in Orca's sidebar, linked to workspaces and agents.

cover.alt: The Redmine logo on a white tile beside the title “Redmine for Orca” and the tagline “Your Redmine tasks in the sidebar, tied to workspaces and agents.”

settings.title: Redmine URL
settings.description: Base address, without a trailing slash. The API key is entered in the panel and stored encrypted.

settings.title: Instructions for a new-workspace agent
settings.description: What the agent launched in a new workspace is asked to do. The task context (description and comments) is appended after it. Placeholders: {id} {subject} {url} {project} {tracker} {status} {priority} {assignee}. Leave empty for a default in Orca's language. It can still be edited in the panel before launching.

settings.title: Prompt for “Send to agent”
settings.description: Typed into a terminal of the current workspace, without pressing Enter. Newlines become spaces. Placeholders: {id} {subject} {url} {project} {tracker} {status} {priority} {assignee}. Leave empty for a default in Orca's language.

settings.title: Comments in the agent context
settings.description: Which task comments go into the context of an agent launched in a new workspace. Can be changed per launch in the panel.

settings.title: Maximum context size (characters)
settings.description: Cap for the task context block. When the full history does not fit, the oldest comments are left out first. Orca uses 12000 for its own integrations.
